style: Hand-drawn cartoon illustration with flat colours and clean black ink outlines, warm cream paper background, soft shadows, friendly and funny. The top third of the picture is plain empty cream paper. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere. Emus have shaggy dark brown feathers, a blue-grey neck and face, a dark grey beak and long grey legs. Australian soldiers of 1932 wear khaki uniforms and wide slouch hats with one side of the brim pinned up. A Lewis gun is a light machine gun with a flat round drum magazine on top and a thick cooling tube around the barrel, on a small bipod.

images.name: e01
images.prompt: On the left, a nervous Australian soldier in a slouch hat lying flat on his stomach behind one old Lewis gun on a small bipod; the gun has a big flat round disc magazine, like a dinner plate, lying flat on top of it. On the right, one big cheeky emu standing proudly, looking straight at him. A golden wheat field behind them.

images.name: e02
images.prompt: A wooden desk seen from above, with a big open notebook with blank white pages in the middle, a yellow pencil lying across the notebook, a round magnifying glass beside it, and a steaming white teacup with an orange stripe. No newspaper, no biscuits, no plate.

images.name: e03
images.prompt: Two Australian soldiers with normal pink skin walking happily along a country road away from a steam ship, one carrying a pitchfork over his shoulder, towards a blank wooden signpost and green farmland. No emus, no guns.

images.name: e04
images.prompt: A wide golden wheat field in the Australian countryside with a small tin-roofed farmhouse, a windmill water pump and a farmer in a straw hat proudly looking at his wheat.

images.name: e05
images.prompt: A huge crowd of emus, dozens and dozens of them, marching over a dusty hill towards a wheat field, looking determined. No people, no soldiers, no guns.

images.name: e06
images.prompt: Outdoors on red dusty ground. On the left, one tall emu with shaggy dark brown feathers, a blue-grey neck and two grey legs standing calmly, side view, much taller than a short wooden fence post next to it. On the right, another dark brown emu running very fast with cartoon speed lines and dust behind it. Only the two emus, no people.

images.name: e07
images.prompt: Emus happily eating a ruined wheat field, a broken wire fence with big holes in it, and cheeky rabbits hopping in through the holes. No people, no soldiers, no guns.

images.name: e08
images.prompt: On the left, a group of angry wheat farmers in straw hats and work shirts shaking their fists. On the right, a tall serious politician in a dark 1930s suit and a round black bowler hat, nodding. A grand white government building with columns in the background, no flag.

images.name: e09
images.prompt: On a dusty country road: an army major with a moustache and a peaked officer's cap, two soldiers in wide slouch hats with one side of the brim pinned up, two Lewis light machine guns lying on the ground (long thin guns with a thick cooling tube and a flat round drum on top, no wheels) and a stack of wooden ammunition boxes.

images.name: e10
images.prompt: A modern office meeting room: a confident manager in a tie pointing at a big blank whiteboard while three bored office workers sit around a table with coffee cups.

images.name: e11
images.prompt: Australian soldiers in khaki wearing wide-brimmed slouch hats with one side of the brim pinned up (no helmets, no caps), crouching with a Lewis gun on a bipod at the edge of a wheat field, looking confused. Far away in the distance, small groups of emus run away in every direction. All emus have dark brown feathers and blue-grey necks.

images.name: e12
images.prompt: On the right, a muddy brown water pond on a farm with many emus drinking the water. On the left, a soldier in a slouch hat looking shocked at his jammed Lewis gun, which has a big flat round disc magazine like a dinner plate on top, with a puff of smoke coming out of it. No writing or signature anywhere.
